description: Add a question attendees answer when they sign up for an open Registration Sheet or Booking Agent, such as a T-shirt size. A text question takes a typed answer; a dropdown question takes a choice from options you list (it needs a Plus or Pro plan). Image questions can't be added here. Emails no one.

allow_multiple.description: For a dropdown: attendees may choose more than one option. Defaults to false.

field_type.description: text for a typed answer, dropdown for a choice from options. Defaults to text.

is_required.description: Attendees must answer it. Defaults to false.

options.description: For a dropdown: the choices, in order. 1 to 30, each 1 to 60 characters, no two the same. Not allowed for a text question.

prompt.description: The question, as attendees will see it.

name: add_custom_field
title: Add a custom field
